name: cheap+signal (nix2)
one_line: Buy the underpriced side when the oracle-lag signal confirms it and the book is fillable; skip toxic-cheap, spikes, and thin books.
why_it_works: EV = win-rate vs entry PRICE, not win-rate alone. The book sometimes underprices a side (crowd piled the other way); the Binance-vs-Chainlink oracle lag independently says that side just ticked up. Cheap + confirmation = a mispricing, not information. Profit is price leverage (win ~52% at ~0.47 = +6-9%/trade), not direction skill.

entry_rules.fill: taker at signal-side top-of-book at T0+250ms, walk book if thin

in_sample_evidence.stability: win rate identical train(51.1)/val(51.1); positive every month; fresh Jul6-8 positive
in_sample_evidence.caveats: NOT pre-registered (found after 6 passes -> discount p); 5m recent era only; small capacity (~$10/trade, decays by $25); pooled with 15m not significant

PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.rule: FROZEN above — do not change any parameter
PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.bar: positive EV AND daily-EV t >= 2.0 over >= 20 trade-days
PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.if_pass: real edge confirmed -> paper-live then small real stakes
PRE_REGISTERED_ONESHOT.if_fail: in-sample mirage -> report negative, do not retune
